incidents.name: TINU transfer-fee burn from pair
incidents.notes: TINU's _transfer charged its fee against the Uniswap pair's own balance, so repeatedly transferring to the pair shrank the token reserve while WETH stayed constant, and the attacker skimmed the resulting price dislocation.

sources.ref: onchain review: TINU 0x2d0e64b6bf13660a4c0de42a0b88144a7c10991f created 2021-06-19T18:45:35Z by 0x777777f9ef0f0193d2ab2ad4ff7381578119259d, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment. ~22 ETH x $1,610.25 at incidentTimestamp 1674717047 (DefiLlama) = $35,426.
